description: Simulates a Cyprus mortgage with a payment schedule that reconciles paid amounts to principal and interest. Supports fixed then variable periods, monthly overpayments, lump sums and interest-only loans; interest-only minimum payments track the remaining balance, with principal due at maturity. KFIK and cash-collateral configurations are not available through this API. Use only to estimate a Cyprus mortgage payment, amortization, overpayments or rate scenarios. Require the actual loan amount, term, selected fixed-period length and the rate inputs for each phase that applies; never substitute example loan terms or rates. EUR amounts and annual percentage rates are expected. For document checklists or general mortgage information, do not call the calculator; answer or research directly without narrating tool selection.

bankMargin.description: Actual bank margin in annual percentage points added to the variable base rate; do not split an all-in rate without confirmation.

closureFee.description: EUR amount. Supply the actual value when applicable; use 0 only when confirmed to be zero.

ercPercentage.description: Early repayment charge, percent of the balance.

ercPeriodYears.description: Years the early repayment charge applies.

feesAddedToLoan.description: Whether upfront fees are capitalised into the loan.

fixedPeriodYears.description: Actual number of years at the fixed rate before variable pricing (0 means fully variable); ask if unknown.

fixedRate.description: Actual all-in annual fixed rate in percent, required when a fixed period applies.

amount.description: EUR amount. Supply the actual value when applicable; use 0 only when confirmed to be zero.

month.description: Month number from the start of the loan.

monthlyOverpayment.description: Extra amount paid each month, EUR.

mortgageAmount.description: EUR amount. Supply the actual value when applicable; use 0 only when confirmed to be zero.

overpaymentPeriodType.description: When overpayments are made across the term.

overpaymentYearsCount.description: Number of years overpayments run when period type is first/last.

upfrontFees.description: EUR amount. Supply the actual value when applicable; use 0 only when confirmed to be zero.

variableBaseRate.description: Actual annual reference rate (such as ECB or Euribor) in percent, for the variable phase.

name: simulate_mortgage
